verdict.rationale: Working Copy keeps user data as standard git repositories, which is an open format. Those repositories can be pushed to any https/ssh/git remote, including self-hosted servers. They are also reachable directly through the Files app, third-party document pickers and a built-in WebDAV server, so a user can take everything out and leave. Missing for 10: documented export of app-specific data such as identities, SSH keys and settings, and independent hands-on reports of migrating fully off the app.
